contract: Each required Shield test binds one minimal contract mutation. In the M-TEST Red phase all production stubs raise NotImplementedError; integration/e2e tests enter via the public CLI and fail at the CLI-routing / event-observation layer before reaching any mutable stub. A mutation applied to a stub the test never reaches cannot change the test outcome, so no counterexample can be killed (verified) until Devon implements the routing that makes the stub reachable. All bindings are therefore pending-implementation; the patches describe the minimal deviation to apply once the routing exists.
